content.title: Anthropic's Stock Drops as AI IPO Fails to Buoy Market
content.caption: Anthropic's stock plummeted on its second day of trading, erasing gains from its IPO and contributing to a broader market downturn.

slides.heading: Anthropic's Stock Drops as AI IPO Fails to Buoy Market
slides.text: Anthropic's stock plummeted on its second day of trading, erasing gains from its IPO and contributing to a broader market downturn.

slides.heading: Market Dips
slides.text: The Nasdaq Composite erased all its gains for 2026 and closed down 5% from its value on 1 January.

slides.heading: AI IPO Failure
slides.text: Anthropic's IPO failed to stem a global sell-off in AI-linked companies, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq erased some $4tn in market value this week.
